haiku.problem: The question says Zophar told Job what to do "to be restored," but the verses never mention restoration. Zophar's words are conditional ("if you put away the iniquity"), and the question states it as an instruction Job "must" follow. It should stick to the verses, e.g. "If Job wanted God to lift up his face again, what did Zophar say he must put away?"
